name: kicad-happy
tagline_zh: 打工人的外挂：kicad-happy。英文简介见下。
desc_en: AI coding agent skills for KiCad electronics design. Works with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Analyze schematics, review PCB layouts, EMC pre-compliance, SPICE simulation, download datasheets, source components, and prep boards for fabrication.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
